newsitem.title: USA: Parker Drilling to acquire rental tool firm.
newsitem.headline: Parker Drilling to acquire rental tool firm.

text.p: Parker Drilling Co said Tuesday it agreed to acquire Quail Oil Tools Inc, a privately-owned tool rental business based in New Iberia, La..
The purchase price was not disclosed but Parker said it will finance the acquisition through the issuance of debt.
Quail rents tools and equipment to oilfield exploration, production and service companies in the Gulf of Mexico.
Parker said the acquisition is part of its strategy to expand its presence in its three major markets - barge and platform drilling, land drilling and rental tools.
Parker is a worldwide drilling contractor.
